svg.text: AIR-FLOW Knee+: current hardware and the web-integration plan
Goal: EMG → control logic → pneumatic actuation → web display. State unfinished capabilities clearly.
From EMG sensing to pneumatic actuation: the working bench hardware chain
Bring physical data to the webpage, then add explainable AI recommendations
Read Arduino data with browser Web Serial
Display EMG values and charts in the browser
Synchronise event states: trigger / execute / reset
Personalised trigger suggestions with explanations of why a trigger did or did not occur
Present the Live Assist interface on the showcase page
First receive a physical sample in the browser, then add AI explanations and synchronised state display
• AI recommends and explains; it does not control the hardware directly
AI suggestion card in the web interface, e.g. a light-assistance recommendation
• No claim of validated stair, fatigue or slope classification
AI explanations in the event timeline, e.g. EMG above the baseline
• No medical conclusions or clinical efficacy claims
These are future enhancements, outside the initial integration chain
Initial AI presentation: suggestions and explanations
Hardware control remains threshold-based; AI provides advisory text
Later: a personalised strategy engine using IMU, angle and pressure inputs
• Integration prototype, not a finished product
Future version: enhanced AI / personalised strategy engine
We demonstrate the verified chain. Remaining functions are roadmap items or interface concepts.
